description: Today was for reflection, remembrance, and gratitude. I was honored to attend Memorial Day ceremonies in the towns of Esopus, LaGrange, and Wappinger as well as the Village of Fishkill parade. But the most meaningful part of my day was getting to share it with my niece and nephew. Teaching them simple things like flag etiquette, watching them wave their flags with excitement, and hoping they grow up remembering what this day stands for. I also had the privilege of passing out flags and putting smiles on faces throughout such a somber and emotional day. In moments of reflection, those small acts of patriotism and community felt exceptionally important. Today, we remembered. We reflected. And we carried forward the responsibility to never take their sacrifice for granted.
